command.addAll.success: Successfully added all enchantments to the blacklist
command.addAll.failure: Failed to add all enchantments to the blacklist, change reverted
command.anvilExperienceCostLimit.descrip: The maximum experience level cost before the anvil refuses to work (Too Expensive!). Cannot be lower than 40
command.anvilExperienceCostLimit.set: Set Anvil Experience Cost Limit to %s
command.anvilExperienceCostLimit.value: Anvil Experience Cost Limit is currently %s experience levels
command.blacklist.not_in: The enchantment %s is not in the blacklist
command.blacklist.removed: Removed the enchantment %s from the blacklist
command.fixedAnvilCost.description: An optional value to fix the experience cost of anvils. Set it to -1 if you don't want to have a fixed anvil cost.
command.fixedAnvilCost.value: Fixed Anvil Cost is currently %s experience levels
command.maxEnchantmentLevel.description: The maximum enchantment level allowed. Settings this to zero will make maximum levels work normally
command.maxTradeLevel.description: Acts as a limiter for maxEnchantmentLevel in librarian trades. Must be lower than maxEnchantmentLevel. Settings this to zero will make maximum levels in librarian trades work normally. Settings this to -1 will limit maximum levels in librarian trades to vanilla maximum levels no matter what Maximum Enchantment Level is set to
command.maxTradeLevel.error: maxTradeLevel cannot be higher than maxEnchantmentLevel
command.noIncompatibilities.description: Allows you to combine mutually exclusive enchantments like Infinity and Mending together. Fortune and Silk Touch is not supported
command.rebalancedTrades.description: Rebalances librarian villager trades for higher enchantment levels. Recommended if maxEnchantmentLevel is higher than 10
command.showActualNumbers.description: Shows the actual level of an enchantment near the roman numerals if enabled
command.update.available: A newer version of Limitless Enchantments is available: v%s
command.update.please: It's recommended you update to this version
limitless.warning.setting.change: You changed a setting. It's recommended to the quit the world and rejoin it!
limitless.thank.you: Thank you for using Limitless Enchantments!
